text: おぬしは　どうじょう　やぶりか！

structure.jp: どうじょう　やぶりか！
structure.en: are a dojo challenger, are you!

patterns.name: 〜か
patterns.span: どうじょう　やぶりか
patterns.explanation: か at the end, said with force, is not a real question here: the speaker has just worked something out and says it aloud. どうじょう やぶりか = 'so you're a dojo challenger!'.
